implementation_map.why: Section 3.A: Canonical Bitget XAUUSDT OHLCV normalization, strict UTC alignment (including 1D session anchor), tick rounding, duplicate/gap/corrupt rejection without synthetic forward-fill.
Section 3.B: Enforces strict closed-candle cutoff (close_time <= decision_time and available_at <= decision_time), excluding partial/future bars.

Section 3.C: Synchronizes H4/H1/M15 (and M5/M1/D1) closed-candle windows from a single source-of-truth, supporting exact UTC bucket resampling without partial HTF leakage and propagating STALE_HTF to per-timeframe window state.
Section 3.D: Hard causal validator failing closed on any bar with close_time > decision_time, available_at > decision_time, or unclosed flag.
Section 4.A-C: Causal pivot detector requiring full right-bar closure, HH/HL/LH/LL/EH/EL + protected swing classification, and closed-candle BOS/CHoCH vs wick-only rejection.
Section 5.A-E: Bounded-diameter EQH/EQL clustering, completed prior-day PDH/PDL derivation, closed-candle sweep vs touch-only vs breakout classification, and absorbing lifecycle state machine.

DEF-02, DEF-03, DEF-05: Enforces fail-closed MTF eligibility across all timeframes/directions, builds isolated A vs B contexts, verifies adapter call_id/origin lineage and mandatory non-null parity fields, and runs true A/B/C/D historical backtest with IndependentPreRefactorBaselineOracle.

DEF-03: Replaces silent except-pass in MTF context construction with MTF_CONTEXT_BUILD_FAILED fail-closed state, enforces mtf_context!=None invariant when VALID, registers unique adapter_call_id per invocation, and propagates MTF eligibility rejection across all return paths.

DEF-01 & DEF-04: Replaces static PASS/0/VERIFIED values with evidence-driven gate evaluators, isolated subprocess failure-sensitivity RED/GREEN probe, full pytest collection inventory reconciliation, and git ls-remote verification.

dataset.quote_construction_detail: Deterministic modeled quote around 1m bar close (bid = close - 0.10, ask = close + 0.10); not historical L1 tick orderbook capture.

backtest.coverage_limitations: Bitget XAUUSDT 1m historical window contains 22376 bars (2026-10-08T05:38:00Z -> 2026-10-28T14:00:00Z); max closed resolved trades across variants is 0, so STRATEGY_STATISTICAL_CONCLUSION=STATISTICALLY_INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE and no win-rate improvement claim is made.
